titles.english: The Adventures of Little Lulu and Tubby
titles.native: リトル・ルルとちっちゃい仲間

description: The series follows the everyday adventures of Little Lulu, Tubby, and the rest of their friends. The most prominent themes derived from the comics include the boys vs. girls rivalry, Tubby's clubhouse, and mishaps with the troublemaking Westside Gang.
